Cor 6.4.  For 321-avoiding w with u_w . mu = lambda, the greedy cylindric chain of lambda/mu has weight sorting to mu(w) = conjugate of the sorted code of w^{-1}; and the minimal number of rows of a cylindric tableau of that shape is the largest entry of c(w^{-1}).  Both sides are old; the identity between them appears to be new.  Proved (Step 3 of the main theorem), and separately checked on 1142 instances over n=3..6 -- a test of the DICTIONARY, not of the mathematics, since it is a theorem.

Remark 5.2.  Lam sec:321 defines 321-avoiding as 'no reduced word contains a SUBSEQUENCE i,(i+1),i'.  Read literally that is strictly stronger than his own Proposition's pattern criterion: w = (-3,4,5) in S~_3 has the unique reduced word 0 1 2 0, which contains 0,1,0 as a subsequence but no braid FACTOR and no 321 pattern.  The proof of that Proposition ('so that w = v s_i s_{i+1} s_i u') shows the factor is meant.  Braid-factor and pattern criteria agree on all 531 elements over n=3,4,5; the literal subsequence reading disagrees on 12.  A wording slip, not a mathematical error.
